name: Fiji Airways
verdict: The Fijian Government holds 51% of Fiji Airways. State ownership alone is not a tier, and no sourced record of serious abuses by the Fijian state is cited. Nothing found.
note: Back-of-shirt sponsor of the Flying Fijians; renewed as Principal Partner of the Fiji Rugby Union through May 2027 (fijivillage, 2 December 2025). Other shareholders reported in 2022: Fiji National Provident Fund 30.02% (a statutory workers' pension fund, not itself a state with a record), Unit Trust of Fiji 1.85%, with Qantas named in the same reporting as the other major shareholder. No UN, HRW, Amnesty or court record of the kind METHOD.md requires was found for the Fijian state; and no human-rights finding against the airline itself.
